Term dates

View our official term dates for current and upcoming academic years at the University of Exeter, including start and end dates for each term.

Note: The dates given below are for standard University terms: however, for some programmes the dates of required attendance may vary. Term dates for alternative programmes are listed underneath. Please note that no teaching takes place on bank holidays.

New students should also be aware that Welcome Week (otherwise known as Freshers' Week) is usually the week immediately before the start of term. Full details can be found on the New Students website.
